valueString.value: NL-PS level 1b: bearer token from your own system for your level 1b test patient

title.value: NL-PS-L1-B - Level 1b: Maximum metadata and empty sections - XML Format

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 1b test patient, in which all metadata is present, and all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. Metadata covers the Composition and the Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Device and Organization in the document; per type, one filled resource is enough. A missing SHALL:populate element fails, a missing SHOULD:populate-if-known element gives a warning. Known issue: of the Organization obligations only name is SHALL; the other SHALL:populate obligations in the profile are treated as SHOULD:populate-if-known. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 1b test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
The id of the first Patient Summary Composition in the search result.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).first().id

description.value: Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient.
Search the Patient Summary Compositions of the patient: GET [base]/Composition?type=http://loinc.org|60591-5
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a searchset Bundle.

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'searchset'

description.value: Confirm that the search result contains at least one Patient Summary Composition. Without one, step 2 cannot run.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).exists()

description.value: Confirm that the search result contains exactly one Patient Summary. If there are more, step 2 uses the first one in the order of the server: check the Composition id in the request of step 2 to see which one was tested. Use a token that only gives access to one test patient to avoid this.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).count() = 1

name.value: Retrieve and check Patient Summary document

description.value: Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check the document as a whole. Check that all metadata is present (SHOULD:populate-if-known elements as a warning), and all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative.
Retrieve the Patient Summary as a document: GET [base]/Composition/[id]/$document
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a Bundle.
Confirm that the Bundle is a document. (FHIR R4 allows a server to wrap the document in a searchset Bundle; that is not accepted here.)

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'document'

description.value: Confirm that the first entry of the document is a Composition.
Confirm that the Composition is a Patient Summary (type LOINC 60591-5).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).type.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '60591-5').exists()

description.value: Confirm that the document conforms to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle, and its resources to the profiles they claim in meta.profile. A resource without meta.profile, such as the Patient or a GBB entry, is only validated against the base FHIR specification for now.

Confirm that the Composition conforms to http://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/StructureDefinition/nl-PatientSummary, and through it to the EU-PS profile it imposes. The Composition does not need to claim the profile in meta.profile.
